file_roles.evidence: The check counted raw responses, 'if (response.size() > 1) throw new CacheLoaderException("Response length is always 0 or 1, received: " + response)'. It becomes a count after deduplication, 'Set<Response> setResponses = new HashSet(responses); if (setResponses.size() > 1) throw ...'. Rejecting two identical answers is the wrong logic the issue title names, and it is corrected here.

rationale: The reported exception text, 'Response length is always 0 or 1, received:', is a literal in the method the fix rewrites, and the single frame given, 'ClusterCacheLoader.load(ClusterCacheLoader.java:57)', points at the same method. The pasted payload shows why it fired: the two SuccessfulResponse entries carry the same TopologyView with the same two addresses, so they are duplicates rather than a genuine conflict. Throw site, defect and fix coincide.
notes: Two commits close this key and both touch only this file. The first deduplicates; the second, 'Optimise when only one response', restructures the loop into a single Response variable and skips the HashSet when only one response arrived. The gold set is one file either way.
